findings.title: Vite Build Output Format Undefined
findings.problem: Design claims 'single www/index.html' but Vite's default output (dist/ with hashed assets) is incompatible with Capacitor. No vite.config.js provided.
findings.impact: Capacitor sync will fail during Android build (blocker)
findings.fix: Specify vite.config.js with outDir: '../www' and rollupOptions for asset naming. Clarify output structure.

findings.title: Game Lifecycle Refactoring Unvalidated
findings.problem: Design assumes all 15 games map to create/mount/pause/resume/destroy lifecycle without gameplay changes. No baseline test provided.
findings.impact: If gameplay breaks, root cause cannot be isolated. Violates regression testing requirement.
findings.fix: Add Phase 0: Execute baseline playtest on all 15 games before modularization. Document win/loss conditions, scoring, high score persistence per game.

findings.title: Storage Validation Schema Incomplete
findings.problem: Design lists 8 fields but current app has 14 fields (owned, avatar, ownedAv, pw, daily, ads, best, day not documented). Incomplete validation risks data loss on migration.
findings.impact: User data (theme unlocks, power-ups, daily streaks) could be silently lost during first load.
findings.fix: Expand defaultState and validateState() with complete 14-field schema. Include type checks and default values for all fields.

findings.title: Game Registry Not Fully Specified
findings.problem: Design shows 2 games (Simon, RPS) but app has 15 games. Complete game list not provided. Implementation requires manual extraction from existing HTML.
findings.impact: Risk of missing games, typos in IDs, or inconsistent metadata during manual extraction.
findings.fix: List all 15 games in design with correct IDs, names, emojis, tints, descriptions, and p2 flags.

findings.title: Audio Context Cleanup Unspecified
findings.problem: Design initializes audio context but never specifies cleanup. Oscillators, gains, buffer sources may accumulate if not explicitly stopped, causing memory leaks.
findings.impact: Extended play sessions (1+ hours) may crash app or become unresponsive. Violates cleanup requirement.
findings.fix: Add stopAllAudio() and cleanupAudioContext() functions. Specify that sfx() oscillators are automatically .stop()'d within their duration. Document lifecycle.

findings.title: Route Parameter Parsing Unspecified
findings.problem: Design shows routes like /game/:id and /lesson/:id/:i but doesn't specify parameter extraction or validation. Invalid routes (e.g., /game/invalid) behavior undefined.
findings.impact: Implementation will guess at parsing logic. Invalid routes could silently fail or access wrong content.
findings.fix: Provide parseRoute() pseudocode or implementation. Specify fallback behavior for invalid routes (redirect to /home). Validate gameId and lessonIndex.

findings.title: UI Components Module Scope Unclear
findings.problem: Design marks extraction as 'optional' but provides no criteria for when to extract. Developer may over-engineer or skip extraction entirely.
findings.impact: Inconsistent abstraction decisions across game modules; reduced maintainability.
findings.fix: Clarify: Extract only if 3+ games duplicate identical patterns. Otherwise mark NOT APPLICABLE. Document YAGNI principle.

findings.title: Theme Application Lifecycle Unspecified
findings.problem: Design says 'apply theme' but doesn't specify: Does page re-render? Does CSS cascade re-evaluate? Does audio theme update synchronously?
findings.impact: Theme switching could visually glitch if CSS custom properties don't cascade correctly.
findings.fix: Clarify: document.documentElement.dataset.theme = themeId triggers CSS cascade automatically. Audio theme (SND) updates on next sfx() call.

findings.title: Module Dependencies Diagram Incomplete
findings.problem: Diagram doesn't show all imports (e.g., does game/runner import storage, audio, events?). Circular dependencies not flagged.
findings.impact: Low risk; minimal implementation difficulty. Developer can infer from context.
findings.fix: Enhance diagram to show all transitive dependencies including storage, audio, utils imports for each module.

findings.title: Acceptance Criteria to Module Mapping Missing
findings.location: Design sections vs. Requirements Acceptance Criteria
findings.problem: Design doesn't map which module satisfies which AC (e.g., AC #23 'themes apply without glitch' → which module verifies?). Traceability unclear.
findings.impact: Minimal; developer can infer. Affects only documentation clarity.
findings.fix: Add AC-to-module mapping table in design for traceability and verification.

verifiedAssumptions: 19 THEMES with complete CSS variable system present
Single state object S with localStorage persistence works
Game high scores in S.gb, lesson completion in S.done
Web Audio API synthesis with theme-aware parameters working
Design preserves all subjects, themes, no feature changes
Vite is appropriate for vanilla JS (confirmed lightweight, Vue-agnostic)
Coding conventions (camelCase, arrow functions) align with workspace rules

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: All 15 games can be refactored to create/mount/pause/resume/destroy lifecycle without gameplay changes
unverifiedAssumptions.evidence: No baseline playtest provided; regression detection impossible

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: Vite bundling produces single www/index.html compatible with Capacitor
unverifiedAssumptions.evidence: No vite.config.js provided; default Vite output (dist/ structure) incompatible with Capacitor

unverifiedAssumptions.assumption: Game modules independently importable without circular dependencies
unverifiedAssumptions.evidence: Only Simon example provided; other 14 games pattern not validated
